name: Carlson Young
bio: Carlson Elizabeth Young is an American actress and filmmaker. She was born in Fort Worth, Texas, to Susan Young and Marshall Young, a geologist. She attended the University of Southern California, where she studied Creative Writing, before leaving to film the first season of Scream: The TV Series (2015).

credits.title: Clashing Through the Snow
credits.overview: Rival publishing editors Ryan Mitchell and Hannah Hendricks are stranded by a holiday snowstorm and forced to share a rental car to New York, where a career-saving deal awaits them both. As roadside mishaps and small-town detours pile up, the holiday spirit begins to melt their fierce rivalry into something unexpected.

But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.
